title: Method Flow child-process start attestation, evidence-credit, and preflight-failure ledger
hypothesis: A typed Method Flow extension can distinguish a parser or launcher failure that executes no evidence-producing child command from a started child process and can withhold replay credit unless a bounded start and completion receipt exist, while retaining every failed attempt.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate parser outcome, launcher outcome, child start token, command fingerprint, completion receipt, timeout state, retained-negative link, and replay count; only one actually started and successfully completed bounded child may receive replay credit.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
